focusAreas.title: Women & Child Empowerment
focusAreas.shortDesc: Pioneering Project Swabhiman to foster nutrition, safety, economic independence, and dignity for women.
focusAreas.fullDesc: Project Swabhiman serves as the flagship women's empowerment initiative of Janseva Pratishthan Foundation. We believe that empowering a woman transforms entire generations. Through vocational tailoring, micro-entrepreneurship incubation, menstrual hygiene education, and rights awareness, we dismantle structural barriers and help women achieve self-reliance.
initiatives: Project Swabhiman micro-enterprise training
Sanitary pad distribution & reproductive healthcare workshops
Financial literacy and bank account onboarding
Legal counsel clinics for domestic rights & safety

focusAreas.title: Education & Digital Literacy
focusAreas.shortDesc: Closing the digital divide with laptop distributions, scholarships, and school retention programs.
focusAreas.fullDesc: Education is the most potent equalizer. The Janseva Pratishthan Foundation actively supports early childhood learning, girl-child school retention, and digital literacy. In our inaugural drive on August 9, 2026, we distributed brand-new laptops to 50 ambitious students from low-income families to ensure their STEM aspirations are never cut short.
initiatives: Digital classrooms & laptop distribution drives
Girl-child secondary school retention mentorship
First-generation learner after-school tutoring
STEM workshops and college scholarship grants

focusAreas.title: Healthcare & Nutrition
focusAreas.shortDesc: Delivering mobile medical camps, preventive screenings, maternal checkups, and nutritional aid.
focusAreas.fullDesc: Access to quality healthcare is a fundamental human right. Our mobile medical vans and volunteer doctors conduct free diagnostics, diabetes/hypertension screenings, eye exams with free spectacles, and comprehensive maternal-child nutritional supplements in underserved settlements.
initiatives: Free weekly mobile health checkup camps
Mother & child nutritional food basket distribution
Free spectacles & cataract surgery facilitation
Mental wellness counseling circles

focusAreas.title: Environment & Animal Welfare
focusAreas.shortDesc: Urban forestry, native tree plantation, community animal feeding, and emergency rescue.
focusAreas.fullDesc: Compassion transcends human boundaries. Our environmental wing runs regular native tree planting drives across public schools and degraded urban zones. Simultaneously, our animal welfare volunteers manage street dog feeding routes, winter coat distributions, anti-rabies vaccination drives, and emergency medical treatment for stray animals.
initiatives: Miyawaki urban forestation & school greening
Daily community stray animal feeding drives
Stray vaccination & reflective safety collar campaign
Plastic-free community cleanliness marathons

focusAreas.title: Rural Transformation
focusAreas.shortDesc: Revitalizing village economies through artisan skilling, clean water, and sustainable farming.
focusAreas.fullDesc: India’s true soul lives in her villages. We partner directly with Gram Panchayats to install community water filtration units, introduce organic farming methods, and help village self-help groups (SHGs) sell handcrafted goods directly to urban markets without exploitative middlemen.
initiatives: Solar-powered clean drinking water kiosks
Handicraft artisan co-operatives with direct market linkage
Soil regeneration and drip-irrigation training
Village community library establishments

focusAreas.title: Urban Renewal & Slum Support
focusAreas.hindiTitle: शहरी सुधार एवं मलिन बस्ती सहायता
focusAreas.shortDesc: Improving sanitation, lighting, and community safety within vulnerable urban settlements.
focusAreas.fullDesc: Rapid urbanization frequently leaves informal settlements without basic civic amenities. Our urban renewal team facilitates community toilet refurbishment, solar street lamp installations, youth recreation zones, and mosquito control fumigation to prevent monsoon-season dengue and malaria.
initiatives: Community sanitation block revamps
Solar street illumination in dark alleys for women safety
Waste segregation and doorstep collection advocacy
Child-safe activity hubs in high-density colonies

focusAreas.title: Arts, Culture & Heritage
focusAreas.shortDesc: Championing indigenous crafts, folk traditions, and empowering marginalized artisans.
focusAreas.fullDesc: As a patron of cultural heritage, founder Shabbir Shaikh holds a deep reverence for India's living traditional arts. We provide direct grants and exhibition platforms for indigenous folk painters, handloom weavers, and traditional performers, ensuring ancient art forms thrive in the modern age.
initiatives: Direct artisan-to-patron exhibition showcases
Handloom skill preservation workshops for young girls
Heritage storytelling circles in public schools
Grants for endangered traditional craft masters

focusAreas.title: Sports for Development
focusAreas.shortDesc: Inspiring youth discipline, mental resilience, and health through athletic training and kits.
focusAreas.fullDesc: During our launch ceremony, sports clothing and athletic gear were distributed alongside academic tools. We believe sports builds tenacity, teamwork, and opens doors to athletic scholarships for underprivileged youth, keeping them steered away from substance abuse and crime.
initiatives: Sports kit & athletic shoe distribution drives
Free coaching in athletics, cricket, and martial arts
Self-defense camps for young girls
Annual Inter-Colony Youth Sports Gala

focusAreas.title: Disaster Management & Relief
focusAreas.shortDesc: Rapid deployment of dry rations, tarpaulins, and emergency medical kits during crises.
focusAreas.fullDesc: When floods, seasonal cold waves, or civic emergencies strike, time is of the essence. Janseva Pratishthan Foundation maintains an active emergency reserve fund to dispatch warm blankets, waterproof shelter sheets, dry rations, and basic medicines within hours of distress calls.
initiatives: Winter night blanket drives for homeless in Delhi NCR
Flood emergency ration and clean water delivery
First aid and emergency evacuation volunteer brigade
Post-crisis livelihood rebuilding seed grants

focusAreas.title: Humanitarian Relief & Dignity
focusAreas.shortDesc: Preserving human dignity through community kitchens, clothing distribution, and elder care.
focusAreas.fullDesc: At the foundation of all our work lies pure human empathy. We organize weekly community feasts (Langar / Annadan), distribute clothes during festive seasons, and support abandoned senior citizens in care homes with medical essentials and warm companionship.
initiatives: Weekend community nutrition & warm meal kitchens
Festive clothing and essentials gifting campaigns
Senior citizen shelter companionship & medical sponsor
Footwear & warm socks distribution drives

focusAreas.title: Social-Justice & Welfare
focusAreas.shortDesc: Championing civil rights, legal counsel, community protection, and welfare equality for all citizens.
focusAreas.fullDesc: True progress requires social justice and inclusive welfare. Our legal aid clinics and social welfare volunteers support underserved families, resolve exploitation disputes, ensure access to government welfare schemes, and uphold human dignity for all.
initiatives: Free community legal aid clinics & counsel
Govt welfare scheme enrollment drives (Ayushman, Pensions)
Elderly and destitute welfare protection networks
Civil rights & equality awareness symposiums

focusAreas.title: Anti-Cyber Crime Awareness
focusAreas.shortDesc: Digital safety workshops, cyber fraud prevention, and youth internet security literacy.
focusAreas.fullDesc: As society undergoes rapid digital transformation, youth and vulnerable populations face growing threats from cyber scams, digital extortion, and online harassment. We conduct comprehensive cyber-safety training in schools and colleges, educating youth on safe internet navigation, digital banking safety, and cyber grievance reporting.
initiatives: School & college cyber fraud prevention workshops
Girls digital privacy & anti-harassment safety modules
Safe online banking & digital transaction literacy
Assistance with National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (1930)

focusAreas.title: Anti-Drugs & Substance De-Addiction
focusAreas.shortDesc: Youth anti-narcotics advocacy, school de-addiction awareness drives, and family rehabilitation support.
focusAreas.fullDesc: Substance abuse threatens the potential of our youth. Janseva Pratishthan Foundation spearheads grassroots anti-drug campaigns, street-theatre sensitization (Nukkad Natak), school pledge drives, confidential peer counseling, and partnerships with certified rehabilitation centers to help addicted youth reclaim healthy lives.
initiatives: Grassroots youth de-addiction & anti-narcotics awareness drives
School & college anti-substance pledge campaigns
Confidential counseling and family support circles
Partnership with certified medical rehabilitation facilities
